newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila court to decide on water case next week.
newsitem.headline: Manila court to decide on water case next week.

text.p: A Philippine court will decide next week on two cases filed against the privatisation of the Manila Waterworks and Sewerage System (MWSS), court officials said on Friday.
Manila regional trial court judge Inocencio Maliaman listed for resolution a petition filed by MWSS workers, who claim they could lose their jobs because of the privatisation, the officials said.

The judge is also hearing another petition to halt the privatisation, filed by a group of local officials of Rizal province near Manila. The local officials say President Fidel Ramos's authority to privatise MWSS lapsed in 1995 and the judge is likely to announce a ruling next week.
The MWSS board on Thursday approved the awarding of privatisation contracts for East and West Manila to consortiums led by Ayala Corp and Benpres Holdings Corp.
Ayala Corp is part of a consortium also including Bechtel Corp of the United States and United Utilities Plc while Benpres is in partnership with Lyonnaise des Eaux SA
